from doorstop.core import item as item_module
from doorstop.core import tree as tree_module
from doorstop.core.vcs import mockvcs
from doorstop.core import importer, exporter, publisher, editor
from doorstop.core.types import UID, Level, Stamp
from doorstop import common

# Helper to create a temporary repository with the mock VCS
@pytest.fixture
def mock_repo(tmp_path):
    """Create a temporary directory and initialise a mock VCS working copy."""
    repo_path = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo_path.mkdir()
    # Initialise the mock VCS directory
    (repo_path / mockvcs.WorkingCopy.DIRECTORY).mkdir()
    wc = mockvcs.WorkingCopy(str(repo_path))
    return wc, repo_path


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test case U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC_001
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC_001(mock_repo):
    """
    Store requirements in a permanent and secure manner
    """
    wc, repo_path = mock_repo

    # Create a simple document with one item
    doc_path = repo_path / "doc1.md"
    doc_path.write_text("## Requirement 1\n\nThis is a requirement.\n")

    # Use the importer to create a document object
    importer.import_file(str(doc_path), "DOC1")

    # The document should now be present in the tree
    tree = tree_module.Tree.from_list([doc_path])
    assert tree.find_document("DOC1") is not None

    # The item should be stored in the mock VCS (i.e. the file exists)
    assert doc_path.exists()

    # The file should be readable and contain the requirement text
    content = doc_path.read_text()
    assert "This is a requirement." in content

    # The item should have a UID derived from the filename
    itm = tree.find_item("DOC1.1")
    assert itm is not None
    assert isinstance(itm.uid, UID)
    assert str(itm.uid) == "DOC1.1"

    # The item should be marked as active by default
    assert itm.active is True

    # The item should have a level of 1 (top level)
    assert itm.level == Level((1,))

    # The item should be stored permanently (file exists after commit)
    wc.commit("Add requirement")
    assert doc_path.exists()
